protocol: Freeze 30 fit, 16 gate and 45 previously seen exploratory no-search test. Four tool attempts per episode for all arms. Fit-only labeled changes in blind answer correctness across every available teacher-prefix transition and future observed rescue/censoring. HCL stores all transition records and two abstract memories. Make two native SkillOpt appends from raw fit contrasts plus abstract guidance, freeze one candidate. After each observed tool compare the two answer drafts, accept or discard; separately choose stop or continue with remaining budget. Only accepted evidence enters the final reader. Use same repaired router and executable crop interface; when continuing past base stop use the same tool menu excluding stop. No test scores passed to the policy. Compare to unchanged repaired baseline verified from original receipts and matched seed-only arbitration without memory or edits. Score frozen candidate on both panels regardless of gate; switch deployed policy only if strictly more gate answers correct. Report paired answers, actual tool costs, acceptance and stop overrides; assess superiority by positive net and paired exact two-sided test separately. Search-required stratum excluded. Shared memoization for identical inputs or tool requests within a case only, count logical tool requests separately.
